hints.title: Use Diagonal Moves Whenever Possible
hints.text: A diagonal move reduces both horizontal and vertical distance simultaneously by 1 in a single unit of time.

hints.title: Apply Chebyshev Distance
hints.text: The minimum time between (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) equals max(abs(x2 - x1), abs(y2 - y1)).

hints.title: Sum Consecutive Pair Distances
hints.text: Iterate through all consecutive pairs of points in the input order and sum their pairwise Chebyshev distances.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating step by step movement point to point is unnecessarily slow when Chebyshev distance yields direct answers.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Evaluating consecutive Chebyshev differences takes a single linear sweep and constant memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize Chebyshev metric where diagonal motion costs 1 time unit.
complexity.notes: Points must be visited in the exact order given.
